source: Existing checked-in NOAA IBTrACS MAIN seasons, 1980-2024; all 45 source hashes and deterministic regeneration checked

newSourceEntry.datasetId: MAP 72 / 8地域の300 km圏内への接近・月別・年代別集計（1980–2024）
newSourceEntry.retrievalPolicy: 同梱MAIN経路から独自集計。各嵐をシーズンごとに1件。分析を開いたときだけ読込。元の年別ファイルのSHA-256を保持。
newSourceEntry.transformation: MAIN tracks with a recorded centre within 300 km of the named city coordinate; one count per SID per SEASON. Month is the closest recorded approach in UTC, earliest in a tie. Wind is the maximum USA_WIND inside the circle (1-minute mean). Translation speed is summed great-circle segment distance / summed hours, using adjacent points both inside the circle, with intervals <=6 hours. Interpolated source positions are retained. All basins, no status or intensity threshold. Zero counts retained; unavailable wind/speed remain null.

basis: Official page describes the publicly available dataset and its citation. The new output summarizes the already-adopted saved tracks; no newly fetched or differently licensed external data or media. Existing attribution/citation retained. No new provider permission or owner decision is claimed.
